#CryptoMarket #CryptoNews #Updates 

#Grayscale Applies for #PolkadotETF, Joining #Dogecoin and #XRP Filings

The crypto fund issuer received #SEC acknowledgement on Monday for a #Cardano fund and has applied to convert its #XRPTrust into an #ETF.

The announcement triggered a surge in meme coin prices. Popular tokens like #Dogecoin (#DOGE) and #Shiba Inu (#SHIB) experienced double-digit gains within hours of the news, with trading volumes spiking significantly.
